Orbit **2.4.0** — D3DMetal DLSS & MetalFX Frame Generation, `D3DM_MAX_FPS`, and RE Engine stability

## Highlights

- Fixed D3DMetal DLSS initialization on GPTK 4 so games like **God of War** detect DLSS Super Resolution (`nvngx_dlss.dll`) and games with `nvngx_dlssg.dll` automatically unlock **DLSS Frame Generation** via MetalFX (with Metal 4 on macOS 27+).
- Unlocked **Frame rate limit** (`D3DM_MAX_FPS`) for D3DMetal alongside DXMT and DXVK, and allowlisted `D3DM_MAX_FPS`, `D3DM_MTL4`, and `D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR` for advanced per-game overrides.
- Hardened **RE Engine** (`Devil May Cry 5`, `Resident Evil 2`, `Resident Evil 3`) DirectX 11 `.ini` fixes to disable vendor GPU extensions and mismatched DirectX 12 capability flags before launch.
- Fixed Windows game presentation to a consistent **1920×1080** virtual desktop with Retina disabled, and separated **D3DMetal DLSS support** from **DXMT spatial upscaling** in global and per-game settings.

This release contains all changes since **v2.2.0**.

## What’s new since v2.2.0

### Fixed

- **D3DMetal DLSS & MetalFX bridge (`nvngx`)** — Orbit now stages both `.orbit/d3dmetal-dlss/x86_64-windows/nvngx.dll` and a symlinked `.orbit/d3dmetal-dlss/x86_64-unix/nvngx.so` (pointing to canonical `libd3dshared.dylib`) on `WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND` alongside `system32/nvngx.dll` and `system32/nvapi64.dll`. Existing game containers self-heal on next launch. Orbit no longer forces `D3DM_VENDOR_ID` unconditionally, letting D3DMetal switch NVIDIA (`0x10de`/`0x2684`) and `NGXCore\FullPath` natively from `D3DM_ENABLE_METALFX`.
- **RE Engine stability (`dmc5config.ini`, `re2_config.ini`, `re3_config.ini`)** — Pre-launch `.ini` normalization now sets `Capability=DirectX11` and `UseVendorExtention=Disable` under `[Render]` alongside `TargetPlatform=DirectX11`, preventing DX12 capability mismatches and vendor-extension hangs without overwriting other user settings.

### Changed

- **D3DMetal frame rate limiting (`D3DM_MAX_FPS`)** — Frame rate limiting now works on D3DMetal in both **Settings → Game graphics** and per-game compatibility overrides, and is preserved when toggling **D3DMetal DLSS support**.
- **GPTK 4 MetalFX & advanced env overrides** — Allowlisted `D3DM_MAX_FPS`, `D3DM_MTL4`, and `D3DM_SUPPORT_DXR` in `WineProfile::validate_options`, and updated Settings copy to accurately reflect that GPTK 4 enables DLSS Super Resolution and DLSS Frame Generation together via `D3DM_ENABLE_METALFX` with no separate D3DMetal frame-generation or VSync toggle.
- **Fixed 1080p virtual desktop & separated DLSS/DXMT controls** — Every Windows launch normalizes to a 1920×1080 virtual desktop with Retina off, and **D3DMetal DLSS support** is configured independently of DXMT-only switches.

## Install or update

**Requirements:** macOS 12 or later, Apple Silicon.

1. Download **`Orbit-2.4.0-aarch64.dmg`** below.
2. Open it and drag **Orbit** to Applications, replacing the previous app when updating.
3. Launch Orbit from Applications. Your existing library, settings, Steam sign-in, and custom themes remain in Application Support.

The `.app.tar.gz` archive is also provided. Verify downloads with **`SHA256SUMS.txt`**.
